caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica means learning to respect the ridges. When the dirt road narrows into a grassy spine, the gradient shifts from a challenge to an invitation to slow down, step off, and breathe. Here, high above the valley, the air is cool, damp, and smelling of wet earth. There are no engines, no crowds, no hurry—just the slow rhythm of your own breath and the green expanse stretching toward the horizon. Some slopes are meant to be ridden; others are meant to be stood upon, letting the view catch up to you.
